failures.boundary: Core creation preflight rejected a reserved protocol contract beneficiary as unavailable instead of a validation error

failures.correction: Explicitly reject factory, registry, graduation engine and guard before optional treasury admission
failures.followup: The second, third and fourth runs passed this preflight

failures.boundary: Layout selector treated the immutable supply read-only display as an interactive touch target
failures.observed: The non-interactive fixed-supply display is 25px tall
failures.classification: Test selector error; on-chain token creation and indexed discovery had already passed
failures.correction: Exclude read-only fields from interactive target selection and separately assert exact 1-billion supply, read-only state and readable mobile font

failures.boundary: Read-only supply font check after full-page screenshot
failures.observed: Assertion failed before per-layout diagnostic fields were saved
failures.classification: Insufficient first-failure diagnostics; failure and screenshot preserved
failures.correction: Save exact value, read-only, font, viewport and pointer media evidence before assertion

failures.boundary: Read-only supply font check after full-page screenshot
failures.expected: Coarse pointer retained in the explicit iPhone emulation context; supply font 16px
failures.observed: Correct supply and read-only state; font 15px, coarse pointer false, touch disabled; interactive inputs remained 44–47px and 16px

failures.correction: Use viewport screenshots, assert unchanged pointer/touch state around capture, and retain all original 16px/44px acceptance requirements
failures.followup: The fifth run passed all strict 16px/44px layout assertions with coarse pointer retained across viewport captures

failures.classification: Test navigation error; original synthetic treasury deployment receipt was preserved and no duplicate was submitted
failures.correction: Explicitly reopen Optional project treasury after refresh, then reconnect and recover the original transaction
failures.followup: The seventh run passed this refresh recovery and archived both verified core creations

failures.observed: Descendant summary selector matched the outer Optional project treasury and nested Recover original treasury transaction summaries
failures.classification: Strict Playwright locator ambiguity; no duplicate transaction or runtime defect
failures.correction: Select the direct-child summary with :scope > summary
failures.followup: The seventh run passed missing-hash recovery and both creation archives

failures.observed: Anvil accepted a 21000-gas transaction into its pending pool without mining; the harness expected an RPC gas error and instead timed out
failures.classification: Incorrect test expectation about intrinsic-gas admission; not evidence of a contract defect
failures.correction: Use a valid 50000-gas envelope and verify an actual mined out-of-gas revert, nonce consumption, exact unchanged claim credit and held funds
failures.followup: The eighth Chromium run passed an actual mined 50000-gas out-of-gas claim, nonce consumption and exact asset/credit rollback

failures.classification: Unresolved browser interaction observation; initial failure did not capture final DOM
failures.correction: Added bounded API request/response/failure records and exact form/input/hydration-state failure capture; no retry or assertion suppression
failures.followup: Both full Chromium and WebKit reruns passed at 378f3c0a after the targeted ready-state/FormData correction 45a36a54, without retries or weakened assertions. The exact original timeout cause was not established; original failures remain preserved.
